title: nitingawali27/rag-knowledge-explorer
summary: RAG-Knowledge-Explorer 是一个基于 Python 的检索增强生成（RAG）探索工具，用于智能文档摄取、语义搜索、嵌入、向量数据库和AI驱动的问答。它利用模型训练和推理技术，结合向量索引和缓存机制，提供高效的文档检索和问答服务。
description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Explorer for intelligent document ingestion, semantic search, embeddings, vector databases, and AI-powered question answering.
